name: mcp_list
description: List tools by layer: management (mcp_*/discovery_*) vs business (protocol.name.op). Default layer=business so agents are not flooded.

layer.description: business = registered adapter tools; management = catalog/discovery; all = both

name: mcp_add
description: Dynamically register a protocol endpoint. Tools appear immediately as namespaced MCP tools (protocol.name.operation).

protocol.description: Adapter protocol. Built-in: alertmanager, amqp, asyncapi, aws_iam, azureblob, bacnet, beanstalkd, browser, caldav, carddav, cassandra, cifs, clickhouse, coap, consul, couchdb, dingtalk, dns, docker, duckdb, elasticsearch, enip, etcd, ethernetip, feishu, fix, ftp, gcs, github, graphql, grpc, http, imap, influx, influxdb, jira, journal, jsonrpc, k8s, kafka, kubernetes, lark, ldap, mariadb, mcp_bridge, memcached, modbus, mongodb, mqtt, mtconnect, mysql, nats, neo4j, nfs, notion, opcua, openapi, openbao, opensearch, os_info, oss, partner, pg, platform_fs, platform_process, platform_service, podman, pop3, postgres, postgresql, prometheus, pubsub, pulsar, qdrant, rabbitmq, redis, s3, s7, sftp, slack, smb, smtp, snmp, soap, solr, sparkplug, sql, sqlite, sqlserver, sqs, tftp, vault, webdav, websocket, wecom, whois, ws, xmlrpc, zookeeper

name.description: Logical name used in tool prefixes and registration id

config.description: Protocol-specific config. openapi: { spec, baseUrl?, allowWrite? }. mqtt: { url, allowWrite? }. soap: { wsdl, endpoint?, soapVersion?, allowWrite? }. grpc: { proto | protoInline | reflection:true, target, allowWrite?, ca?|caFile?, cert?|certFile?, key?|keyFile? }. asyncapi: { spec, brokerUrl?, bind?, allowWrite? }. sparkplug: { url, groupId?, edgeNode?, hostId?, encoding?, allowWrite? }. websocket: { url, allowWrite? }. graphql: { url? | simulator:true | wsUrl?, allowWrite? }  (subscribe_once = graphql-ws; HTTP is query/mutate). amqp: { url? | simulator:true, queue?, allowWrite? }  (publish/rpc 写闸; get/ack/nack). kafka: { brokers, topic?, groupId?, groupInstanceId?, idempotent?, transactionalId? (recorded, unused), allowWrite? }. fix: { sender?, target?, allowWrite?  (logon/logout/NOS are writes; encode/decode/status are not) }. opcua: { endpoint, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (wait_data_change = memory monitored-item; subscribe_once 仍一次性). modbus: { host, port?, mode?: tcp|rtu, unitId?, simulator?, allowWrite? }. coap: { host, port?, allowWrite? }. nats: { servers | url | simulator:true, allowWrite? }  (JetStream consumer/ack/interest 子集). xmlrpc: { url, allowWrite? }. jsonrpc: { url, allowWrite? }. redis: { url, allowWrite? }. smtp: { host, from?, raw?, starttls?, allowWrite? }  (send_mail 写闸; noop 只读; raw:true 走 EHLO/MAIL/DATA; 不是 IMAP/POP3). ldap: { url, base?, tls?, starttls?, allowWrite? }. bacnet: { host?, port?, deviceId?, devices?, udp?, allowWrite? }. ethernetip: { host?, port?, tcp?, tags?, allowWrite? }  (alias enip; CIP List Identity + local tags). s7: { host?, port?, rack?, slot?, tcp?, allowWrite? }  (ISO-TCP/S7comm Read Var subset). mtconnect: { url | fixture | xml }. sql: { driver: sqlite|postgres|mysql|sqlserver|duckdb, filename? | url?, allowWrite? }  (prefer specific protocol ids). sqlite: { filename?, native?:true (optional better-sqlite3), allowWrite? }. postgres: { url? | simulator:true | native:true + url (optional pg), allowWrite? }. mysql: { url? | simulator:true | native:true + url (optional mysql2), allowWrite? }  (MariaDB compatible; alias mariadb). sqlserver: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }. duckdb: { filename? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }. mongodb: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }  (无 url 内存; url 走 OP_MSG hello/find/insert/listCollections; 无 aggregation). elasticsearch: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }  (url 走 HTTP _cat/_search/_doc; 写闸). opensearch: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }  (ES 兼容 HTTP). clickhouse: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }  (HTTP POST query FORMAT JSONEachRow; INSERT/DDL 需 allowWrite). neo4j: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }  (http(s) /db/{db}/tx/commit; bolt 仍需注入 connectFn). qdrant: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }. s3: { bucket, endpoint?, allowWrite?, unsigned?, accessKey?, secretKey?, region?, simulator? }. gcs: { bucket, endpoint?, allowWrite?, unsigned?, token?, simulator? }. oss: { bucket, endpoint?, allowWrite?, unsigned?, accessKey?, secretKey?, simulator? }. influx: { bucket, url?, org?, token?, allowWrite? }  (alias influxdb; Flux + /api/v2/delete; not InfluxQL). prometheus: { url? | simulator:true, timeoutMs?, allowWrite? }  (query/query_range; remote_write protobuf+snappy 需 allowWrite). sqs: { queue, endpoint?, unsigned?, allowWrite? }. pulsar: { topic, serviceUrl? (memory:// | http + unsigned | pulsar:// official LOOKUP | pulsar:// + dialect=e2p1 | pulsar+ssl://), tenant?, namespace?, subscription?, unsigned?, dialect?, allowWrite? }. snmp: { host?, port?, community?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (SNMPv2c Get/GetNext/walk/Set; not v3/USM). webdav: { url?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (PROPFIND/GET/PUT/DELETE/MKCOL). ftp: { host?, port?, user?, password?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (LIST/RETR/STOR/DELE; not SFTP/FTPS). etcd: { url?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (v3 HTTP KV range/put/delete; not watch/lease). imap: { host?, port?, user?, password?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (IMAP4rev1 LIST/SELECT/FETCH/SEARCH; APPEND/STORE/EXPUNGE 需 allowWrite; 不是 SMTP). pop3: { host?, port?, user?, password?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (STAT/LIST/RETR; DELE/RSET 需 allowWrite; 不是 SMTP). consul: { url?, token?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (HTTP KV + catalog/health; 写需 allowWrite; 无 Connect). azureblob: { container, endpoint?, unsigned?, sasToken?, account?, accountKey?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (SharedKey 子集或 SAS 查询串; 写需 allowWrite). sftp: { host?, port?, user?, password?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (SSH-2 SFTP; 不是 FTP). memcached: { host?, port?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (text GET/SET/DELETE/STATS). tftp: { host?, port?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (RFC1350 RRQ/WRQ; 不是 FTP/SFTP). caldav: { url?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (PROPFIND/REPORT time-range + freebusy; iTIP schedule E_UNSUPPORTED). carddav: { url?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (PROPFIND/REPORT addressbook-query/GET/PUT). beanstalkd: { host?, port?, tube?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (put/reserve/delete/stats). zookeeper: { host?, port?, simulator?, allowWrite? }  (ruok + get/create + watch_once + multi; ACL/SASL E_UNSUPPORTED). dns: { host?, port?, simulator?, timeoutMs? }  (unicast A/AAAA/TXT/PTR; 无 AXFR / 无组播). cassandra: { host? | url? | simulator:true, port?, allowWrite? }  (CQL 子集; native v4 STARTUP/QUERY; 写闸). couchdb: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }  (_all_dbs / _all_docs / GET / PUT; 写闸). whois: { host? | url? | simulator:true, port? }  (TCP 43 只读 query). solr: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }  (select/update HTTP; 写闸; 不是 SolrCloud admin). rabbitmq: { url? | simulator:true, vhost?, allowWrite? }  (management HTTP 15672; 不是 AMQP 0-9-1). kubernetes: { url? | simulator:true, namespace?, token? }  (只读 list/get/logs pods; exec/apply E_UNSUPPORTED). os_info: { }  (本机 OS/arch 只读; 热加载，不在 boot 强制挂载). platform_fs: { roots?, maxBytes? }  (gated list/read; 默认拒绝 / ; 不可 allowWrite). platform_process: { allowShell?, listFn? }  (process_list; shell_exec 闸+stub). platform_service: { allowShell? }  (systemd/sc/launchctl best-effort; 缺工具 E_UNSUPPORTED). docker: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }  (Engine API 只读 list/inspect/logs; run E_UNSUPPORTED). podman: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }  (docker-compat API; 同 docker). journal: { path? | simulator:true, format?: syslog|journal-export|evtx-xml, allowShell? }. smb: { host? | simulator:true, port? }  (别名 cifs; 模拟 list/get; live 仅 SMB2 NEGOTIATE). nfs: { host? | simulator:true, port? }  (NFSv3 NULL ping; live SHOWMOUNT E_UNSUPPORTED). vault: { url? | simulator:true, token?, allowReadSecrets? }  (health/list keys; 读 secret 默认关; 别名 openbao). aws_iam: { simulator:true }  (永不打 IMDS; live STS E_UNSUPPORTED). alertmanager: { url? | simulator:true, allowWrite? }  (alerts/status 只读; create_silence 写闸). pubsub: { url? | simulator:true, project?, allowWrite? }  (GCP Pub/Sub emulator HTTP; publish 写闸). jira: { url? | simulator:true, token? }  (myself/search/get_issue 只读). browser: { allowDesktop? }  (默认关; 即使打开也不启动 Chrome). partner: { capability_id, operations[], invoke:{kind:http,url} | simulator:true, heartbeatTtlMs?, allowWrite? }  (E2MCP Partner; 应用不实现 MCP). feishu: { url? | simulator:true, token?, allowWrite? }  (list_chats/search 只读; send_message 写闸). dingtalk: { url? | simulator:true, token?, allowWrite? }  (probe 只读; work notice / robot 写闸). wecom: { url? | simulator:true, token?, allowWrite? }  (dept/user 只读; send_app_message 写闸; 不是个人微信). slack: { url? | simulator:true, token?, allowWrite? }  (conversations.list 只读; post_message 写闸). notion: { url? | simulator:true, token?, allowWrite? }  (search/get_page 只读; create_page 写闸). github: { url? | simulator:true, token?, owner?, repo?, allowWrite? }  (issues/PRs 只读; create_issue 写闸). mcp_bridge: { mcpServers | path, simulator? }  (兜底导入 mcpServers JSON; live spawn E_UNSUPPORTED)

name: mcp_update
description: Update an existing registration's config and reconnect/reload its tools

name: mcp_remove
description: Disconnect an adapter and unregister its tools (same Catalog path as capability_unregister). Control-plane: does not require allowWrite.

name: mcp_query_by_protocol
description: Filter live adapters and tools by protocol type

name: mcp_health
description: Process + adapter health snapshot for agents (live/restore_failed, tool counts)

name: mcp_explain_tool
description: Explain a namespaced MCP tool: adapter, protocol, local operation, input schema

name: mcp_plan_bridge
description: Turn a natural-language goal into recommended protocols, example configs, and next MCP tool calls. Does not scan by itself.

goal.description: What the agent wants to connect or automate

host.description: Optional single hostname/IP to include in the plan

name: mcp_add_from_discovery
description: Register an adapter from a discovery_suggest payload (protocol + name + config + confidence)

name: schema_import
description: Import OpenAPI, WSDL, proto, GraphQL SDL, or AsyncAPI from a URL or file (OpenAPI servers[] become config.baseUrl). OData / JSON:API / tRPC / Connect-RPC are import-first: export OpenAPI (or pass gRPC target for Connect proto).

kind.description: Force schema kind; otherwise auto-detect. odata/jsonapi/trpc/connectrpc are import-first.

url.description: GraphQL HTTP endpoint when importing SDL

name: mcp_blacklist_list
description: List operator blacklist entries. Match key is canonical protocol + host + port (or normalized url). See docs/BLACKLIST.md.

name: mcp_blacklist_add
description: Add a blacklist entry. kind=target (default): protocol + host+port or network url; blocks mcp_add, discovery register and invoke on matching adapters. kind=capability: adapterId (protocol:name); hides and blocks that one instance. kind=tool: pattern (exact tool name or glob, * = one segment, ** = any, e.g. redis.*.flushall); hides and blocks matching tools. Blacklist still applies in Full mode.

url.description: Network URL; file paths are ignored

name: mcp_blacklist_remove
description: Remove a blacklist entry by id (protocol|host|port, cap|<adapterId>, or tool|<pattern>)

name: environment_inventory
description: On-demand Environment Plane snapshot (OS/arch, permission hints, listening ports best-effort, runtimes, container clues, config paths). Feeds suggest only — never auto-registers, never sets allowWrite=true.

name: capability_register
description: Hot-add a capability through the shared Policy Gateway (same path as mcp_add). Pass a suggestion or protocol/name/config. auto:true only works for Safe + readonly + non-blacklist. Suggest never bulk-registers.

name: capability_unregister
description: Hot-delete a live capability through the shared Policy Gateway (same path as mcp_remove). Removes the adapter instance and its tools immediately. Control-plane: does not require allowWrite. Console REST requires confirm:true. Missing id is E_NOT_FOUND.

name: capability_configure
description: Reconfigure a live capability (same path as mcp_update). Does not silently enable writes.

name: partner_list
description: List southbound Partner connections (ingress=partner). Agent-facing northbound is still MCP only. Apps do not implement MCP.

name: compat_scan
description: Compat Catalog scan: P0 installed∩catalog + Partner drops; P1 login clues; P2 ports; P3 mcpServers as mcp_bridge 兜底 only; P4 desktop UI deferred. Scan never opens write/desktop/secrets.

name: discovery_suggest
description: Map probe/scan candidates to one-click mcp_add drafts (protocol, name, config, confidence). Pass candidates or a host to scan first.

name: discovery_probe
description: Probe a single host+port for common OpenAPI/SOAP/GraphQL paths. CIDR / ranges are never allowed.

host.description: Hostname or single IP. CIDR / ranges / wildcards are never allowed.

name: discovery_scan_host
description: Parallel single-host discovery: OpenAPI/WSDL/GraphQL paths, gRPC reflection, Redis PING, MQTT CONNECT, Modbus, CoAP, NATS INFO, JSON-RPC/XML-RPC, Pulsar 8080/6650, GCS 4443, Influx 8086, OSS headers, SMTP 25/587 220-banner. CIDR / ranges are never allowed (EVERYTHING2MCP_DISCOVERY_ALLOW_SCAN is ignored). Timeouts + SSRF (blocks metadata IPs).

host.description: Single hostname or IP. CIDR / ranges / wildcards are never allowed.

port.description: If set, HTTP probes this port; well-known protocol ports still tried unless onlyGivenPort
